name: ANNEXA-I
fullName: Andexanet for Factor Xa Inhibitor-Associated Acute ICH
population: n=530, ≥18, NIHSS n/a, ≤15 h from last FXa dose, ≤6 h from ICH onset
teachingPoint: AHA/ASA 2022 lists andexanet as Class IIa for FXa-associated ICH; ANNEXA-I refines hemostatic-vs-thrombotic trade-off.

name: ANNEXA-4
fullName: Full Study Report of Andexanet Alfa for Bleeding Associated with Factor Xa Inhibitors
population: n=352, mean 77, NIHSS acute major bleeding, ≤18 h after factor Xa inhibitor dose
finding: Anti-Xa activity reduced 92% (apixaban and rivaroxaban); excellent/good hemostasis 82% (204/249)
teachingPoint: Established andexanet reverses anti-Xa activity with 82% good hemostasis, at a 10% 30-day thrombotic event rate.
